message: Scribe is documentation software that records the steps of a procedure performed in an application and turns them into a step-by-step how-to guide for an IT team to share. Verified product facts support this first-email scope: On the free Basic plan the buyer can create an account and, in their browser, manually walk through one IT procedure they currently only hold in their head (for example a browser-based software setup or account configuration) and have Scribe generate it as a how-to guide they can share. Draft this documented use. Treat recipient circumstances as unconfirmed.
